name: character_merch
description: Character merch pipeline: validated character → Jev judges merch fit → agent drafts product line → OddHobb/Etsy listing draft → Prodigi fulfillment check → human approves each product. Characters sell like Earl (Shopify merch $2.99-$49.99), fulfilled through OddHobb print network.

ready_for_merch.description: Does this character have enough audience recognition and distinctive identity to sell merch? Need memorable catchphrases, visual identity, or fan demand.

best_category.description: Which merch category fits best: apparel (shirts/hoodies), plush (teddy/figures), stationery (magnets/cards/paper), audio (theme song/ringtones), bundle (multi-product set)?

steps.label: draft-product-line
steps.instructions: You are a character merch strategist. Given the character and the chosen merch category, draft exactly 3 products. Price to avatar farm norms: apparel $19.99-39, plush $29-49.99, stationery $11.99-12.99, audio $2.99, bundle $47-59. Each product needs: name (character-branded, e.g. 'Nolan's Compliance Mug'), type, price_usd, prodigi_sku (use format apparel_basic_tee, plush_12in, mug_11oz, sticker_pack, art_print_a4 — or empty if unsure), why (1 sentence connecting to character identity). Earl precedent: theme song $2.99, magnets $12.99, wrapping paper $11.99, teddy $49.99. Return JSON with products array.

steps.label: build-merch-plan
steps.code: s => { const prods = ((s.line && s.line.products) || []).slice(0, 3); return { plan: { character_id: s.character_id, brand: s.brand, category: (s.fit && s.fit.best_category) || 'bundle', products: prods, fulfillment: 'oddhobb-etsy + prodigi-print', total_skus: prods.length, needs_review: true } }; }

steps.label: human-approves-merch
steps.summary: Merch plan for {plan.character_id}: {plan.total_skus} SKUs in {plan.category} via {plan.fulfillment}.
